tsbs.title: CVT drive belt can wear early (warranty extended)
tsbs.plain_summary: The steel belt inside the CVT automatic on some 2016-2020 HR-Vs can wear out early. Cars that got the software update in bulletin 21-046 watch the belt and can set code P271E. For those cars Honda lengthened CVT coverage. A dealer checks your VIN.

coverage.term: 7 years or 150,000 miles, whichever comes first (only for cars that received the 21-046 software update)

links_to_issue: CVT drive belt can wear out early
